name: Carla Thompson

text.trigger: Carla searches while her player is still in the colony.
text.vignette: The house Carla is combing is not as empty as it looked from the road. Something in a stained coat paces the upper landing, one hand resting on a holster, and its head turns slowly toward the stairs.

options.face-it: She goes up to meet it: roll for exposure twice on Carla, and if she survives, morale rises by 1.
options.back-away: She retreats one stair at a time and leaves. Nothing happens.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #75; survivor card; trigger point action.search is a stand-in for "controls Carla". SIMPLIFIED: the morale gain is a node-level then after the exposure and so also runs if Carla dies (the DSL has no "if the survivor lived" test)
